infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take a photo of your ticket so the assistant can read the PNR / train number off it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to attach a ticket photo from your gallery.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to submit your current position when you tap "Report my position" on a train you're riding, so other passengers get a more accurate live position (Crowd-Sourced Train Position Reports).

plugins.photosPermission: Used to attach a ticket photo from your gallery.
plugins.cameraPermission: Used to take a photo of your ticket.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Used to submit your current position when you tap "Report my position" on a train you're riding (Crowd-Sourced Train Position Reports).
